name: small-worlds
description: 設定から育てるブラウザゲームの開発基盤

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:legacy
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.format: prettier --write src e2e *.ts *.json *.jsonc index.html public/404.html README.md docs .github .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src e2e *.ts *.json *.jsonc index.html public/404.html README.md docs .github .prettierrc.json
